title: jaltomata contorta
intro: Jaltomata contorta, commonly known as twisted jaltomata, is a plant species in the nightshade family (Solanaceae) native to Mexico. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and alleviating pain. The health benefits of Jaltomata contorta are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycoalkaloids, phenolic compounds, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
